description: Header file defining the Switch configuration API (user space part), including data structures, function prototypes, and enums for switch device management and attribute handling.

classes.name: switch_dev
classes.description: Represents a switch device with configuration and state information.

classes.name: switch_val
classes.description: Represents a value for switch attributes, including data type and associated data.

classes.name: switch_attr
classes.description: Represents a switch attribute with metadata such as name, description, and type.

classes.name: switch_port
classes.description: Represents a switch port with ID and flags.

classes.name: switch_portmap
classes.description: Represents a mapping of virtual port to segment.

classes.name: switch_port_link
classes.description: Represents link parameters for switch ports, including speed and flags.

methods.name: swlib_print_portmap
methods.description: Prints port mapping information for a switch device.

methods.name: swlib_connect
methods.description: Connects to a switch via netlink, returning a chain of switch_dev structures.

methods.name: swlib_free
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated data for a switch connection.

methods.name: swlib_free_all
methods.description: Frees all switch devices in the chain.

methods.name: swlib_scan
methods.description: Probes the switch driver for available commands and attributes.

methods.name: swlib_lookup_attr
methods.description: Looks up a switch attribute by name and group.

methods.name: swlib_set_attr
methods.description: Sets the value of a switch attribute.

methods.name: swlib_set_attr_string
methods.description: Sets the value of a switch attribute from a string, with type conversion.

methods.name: swlib_get_attr
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a switch attribute.

methods.name: swlib_apply_from_uci
methods.description: Configures switch settings from a UCI package.
